title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Continue by binding more real domain authorities to the existing discovery/relationship/instrumentation seams, not by expanding Management into a domain implementation.
invariants: Do not widen Management with provider-specific vocabularies when a specialist object/service can publish its own intention surface.
Rebase Instrumentation Intentions against current Instrumentation Mesh dev8 additive event/correlation contracts without granting command authority.
Bring real machine/service/cloud/GPU/LLM/RexxOS intention providers onto the same dynamic advertisement seam.
Use current Network Transport Intentions dev3 and current transport providers rather than the older dev8 qualification vendor slices when building a new network increment.
Preserve cross-plane contradictory evidence rather than collapsing it into one UP/DOWN boolean.
Before any mutating management intention is enabled, bind current Access Permissions/policy, READY/COMMIT confirmation and domain-specific revalidation at execution time.
Keep package qualification baselines immutable; record newer Library supersessions separately.
For MVS, preserve ED209Z and ED209ZZ as distinct guest identities with explicit host/session provenance; never allow observations to migrate between them.
Terminal Machine owns terminal/session/screen/field truth; MVS Alchemy/JES owns guest/job/dataset truth; Hercules Services owns emulator/control-plane truth; s3270/c3270 is reference evidence only.
MVS batch success is determined from JES step/spool evidence and domain output, not from submission acceptance or a host-side process return.
procedure: Reconcile Library and repository heads before each new increment.
Prefer native domain objects and injected authority contracts over shell/CLI shortcuts.
Add a specialist provider and relationship/instrumentation adapters in that domain package.
Advertise the specialist transiently from related authoritative objects.
Qualify fresh discovery by changing authoritative state and repeating identical natural language.
Record provenance and update this sphere when the architectural contract changes.
Rebase the MVS Intention Terminal Machine consumer from its historical candidate8 qualification pin to current Terminal Machine candidate12 without weakening the authority split.

Run same-session ED209Z Terminal Machine versus s3270 differential qualification, then repeat independently on ED209ZZ; compare field geometry/protection/MDT/cursor/visible content and retain contradictions.
For JES/batch workflows, capture job identity, step RCs, diagnostics and the authoritative spool/output artifact before declaring success or modifying source.
